snippet.title: MEGANAUT - Official Updated Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
I've taken community feedback from the first demo and updated it, as well as EXTENDED it a little bit longer!

You can download the new demo on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708790/MEGANAUT_Demo/

Originally announced at the Indie Horror Showcase, by DreadXP here:
https://youtu.be/kCPsooeH12A?si=zsUwj_cWfj7IqFwQ
